verdict.rationale: cubic ships an in-product AI chat/assistant that users can direct — e.g., 'tour this PR', ask clarifying questions on review comments, 'Fix with cubic' to auto-generate and push a fix, and configurable 'custom agents' — which counts as delegating tasks to a built-in assistant. However this delegation is scoped narrowly to code-review/PR workflows rather than general-purpose task delegation, and no independent/hands-on evidence corroborates the chat/delegation UX specifically (community comments focus on review-comment quality, not the assistant interaction itself). Missing for 10: independent corroboration of the chat/delegate-to-assistant experience, evidence of broader (non-review) task delegation.
